documents.text:
Subject: scam - puppy - need my money back pls

Hello,

I want to make a complaint about a payment I made on Thursday 1st October. I paid £650 to someone selling a cockapoo puppy on social media (a page called 'Malvern Hills Cockapoos'). They had loads of photos and videos of the puppies with the mum and he said I had to pay to hold her because 3 other people were interested. He said his name was [PERSON_2] and the account name was R [PERSON_3]. I sent it by bank transfer in your app.

He said we could collect her on Saturday from an address near Ledbury. My boyfriend [PERSON_1] drove us there and it was just a farm track, there was no house with that number. [PERSON_2] stopped answering my messages and by Saturday night the page had been deleted. I feel so stupid, we'd already bought her a bed and everything.

When I paid, the app showed a message asking if I was sure but it was just the usual 'could this be a scam' thing, it didn't say anything about pets or paying deposits to people you don't know. It also said the name matched so I thought it was fine.

I reported it on the app chat on Saturday night (3rd) and got a reference but nobody has called me. I've seen on the news that banks have to pay back scams now. I want the £650 back please.

My number has changed, please use [PHONE_1] not the old one.

Thanks
[CUSTOMER]

Tried [PHONE_1] from her email, no answer, VM left asking her to call back, no acct details left. Contact details to be updated once ID&V done. Referring to F&S. - [STAFF]
